definitions.above_floor_at_pool_is_payroll_receivers: Under `drawdown` at the pool per node, the runs in which the nodes above the floor at the close are exactly the payroll receivers. Null where every node receives payroll.
definitions.accrued_after_leaving: Under `exit`: over the nodes out at the close, holdings in the last history row less holdings in the history row of the round each last left, summed. On the plain carrier all of it is payroll, since a departed node neither spends nor trades; on the asset carrier it also carries each round's asset settlement. Null under `drawdown`, where nobody leaves.
definitions.below_floor_close: The same count as `starved`, read the same way under each rule.
definitions.below_floor_peak: The largest per-round count of that state over the run, from the model's own per-round column.
definitions.below_node_rounds_financial, below_node_: Node-rounds spent out or below the floor, in each of the two sets.
definitions.below_rounds: Rounds in which at least one node is out (`exit`) or below the floor (`drawdown`).
definitions.claims_moved_after_record: The largest per-node difference between claims settled and claims recorded. On the plain carrier there is no settlement step and no units, the three accounts are one vector and this is 0.0.
definitions.claims_recorded: The last history row, written before that round's asset settlement, units held not included. Read by `gini_close`, `gini_close_trading`, `mr_close`, `mara_close`, `support_ratio`, `claims_conserved`, `frozen_share_claims_recorded` and the denominator of `frozen_share_close`.
definitions.claims_settled: The model's claims after the last round's asset settlement. Read by `gini_claims_settled`, `frozen_holdings`, the numerator of `frozen_share_close` and `frozen_share_claims_settled`.
definitions.drawdown_phase: The registered `drawdown` grid at one round fewer and one round more than the record, with the four criteria evaluated on each, and the closing count of the complete graph at the pool per node as [grace, seed, count].
definitions.drift_against_stratified: With the adjacency moved and the rules held, which nodes pay and receive payroll (Jaccard against the stratified arm) and the opening vector's rank correlation with the stratified one (null where one vector is constant).
definitions.ever_below_financial, ever_below_product: Nodes out or below the floor in at least one round, in each set.
definitions.exit_corners: The exit rule's two switches on the stratified graph, each corner on the registered grid. `dgini` is the closing Gini less the stratified floor-off control, paired by seed; `dgini_less_accrual` does the same with each node out at the close set back to what it held when it last left. `arrival_per_round_*` are the smallest and largest one-round increases in holdings of a node out in both rounds. `identical_to_absorbing_corner` compares the whole holdings history and the per-round masks with the absorbing corner of the same payroll setting.
definitions.frozen_holdings: Claims settled held at the close by the nodes counted in `starved`. Under `drawdown` those nodes are still trading and this is what the nodes below the floor hold.
definitions.frozen_share_claims_recorded, frozen_sha: The same share with numerator and denominator on one account.
definitions.frozen_share_close: `frozen_holdings` over the claim total in the last history row, so claims settled over claims recorded. Under `drawdown` it is the share held below the floor.
definitions.gini_close_less_accrual: Under `exit`: the Gini of the last history row with each node out at the close set back to what it held in the round it last left. Null under `drawdown`.
definitions.gini_close_trading: The Gini of the last history row over the nodes not counted in `starved`. Under `drawdown` every node is still trading and this is the Gini over the nodes above the floor at the close.
definitions.graph_arms: Each arm under both exit rules on the registered grid, read against the stratified arm under the same rule: paired by seed, floor and grace, the closing gap where both fire and the path gap on every floor-on pair. The adjacency arms are the s = 1 endpoint of A7's continuum and a different economy from the registered complete-graph control, so no arm is read against that control.
definitions.net_worth: Claims settled plus units held at the closing price. Read by `gini_net_worth`.
definitions.path_rate_financial, path_rate_productio: Node-rounds out or below the floor over nodes times rounds.
definitions.returns: Node-round transitions from out or below the floor back into the market or above it.
definitions.round_gap_max: The largest per-round absolute difference between the production set's rate and the financial set's rate.
definitions.rule_overlap: Per floor and grace, the closing sets under the two rules on the stratified graph: out under `exit`, below the floor under `drawdown`, both, and each alone. Means over seeds.
definitions.starved: Under `exit`: nodes out of the market at the close, a membership state; in the registered corner nobody comes back. Under `drawdown` nobody leaves and all nodes stay in the graph and keep trading: it counts nodes below the floor in the closing round, a state re-read every round.
